    The residue algebra of split basic data #

    For split basic data (e_x) of B, the scalar c_x(b) with e_x b e_x ≡ c_x(b) e_x modulo the radical defines an algebra map B → k^ι with kernel the radical (SplitBasicData.residue). Its quotient isomorphism turns our split basic data into the split-basic idempotents of the ported BGRS theory (SplitBasicData.toIdempotents).
